Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, frail but determined. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

JACOB: (tearfully) Oh, Thank You. I Never Thought I'd See The Day.

The officials and reporters swarm around him, congratulating him on his achievement. Jacob is beaming with pride, his eyes shining with tears.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the certificate and plaque on his nightstand. He looks at them with a mix of emotions, nostalgia and wonder. He takes a deep breath, and begins to speak to himself.

JACOB: (whispering) You Know, I Used To Think I Was Just A Number. A Statistical Anomaly. But Now I'm The Oldest Human To Ever Live.

As he speaks, Jacob's eyes glaze over, and he becomes lost in thought. He starts to recall a theory he read on the internet in his youth, "Quantum Immortality".

JACOB: (mumbling to himself) Quantum Immortality... The Idea That Every Time A Person Dies, The Universe Creates A Parallel Universe Where They Survived. It's The Only Way To Explain Why I've Been So Lucky.

Jacob's eyes widen, and his voice rises in excitement.

JACOB: (excitedly) But What If I'm Not Just Lucky? What If I'm The Only One Who Survived? What If I'm The Only One Who Exists?

As Jacob's words become more frantic, his body begins to shake. He starts to sweat, and his eyes roll back in his head.

JACOB: (screaming) I'M THE ONLY ONE! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S BEEN THROUGH ALL THE AGES! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S SEEN IT ALL!

The room around Jacob begins to distort and blur, and he becomes lost in a sea of chaos. He starts to laugh maniacally, and his body contorts in ways that defy human possibility.

CUT TO:

EXT. JACOB'S HOUSE - NIGHT

The camera pans across the house, showing the certificate and plaque on the nightstand. The room is dark, and the only sound is Jacob's maniacal laughter. The camera zooms in on the certificate, and the words "Oldest Human To Ever Live" seem to fade away, replaced by a single phrase: "Quantum Immortality".

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
